dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple O-shaped structures exhibit crenulated, high-contrast outer perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from dark-grey exterior to light-cream interiors, most distinct in the lower-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of irregular, solid light-intensity clusters localized along the upper dorsal ridge, lacking internal gradients or defined annular centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lower-lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forming a roughly linear chain extending toward the posterior.
